Topic 3.4: Answering

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Answering. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. summarise texts read by identifying main ideas
2. determine the meaning of unknown words in context

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. summarise texts read by identifying main ideas
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to summarise texts read by identifying main ideas. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. determine the meaning of unknown words in context
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to determine the meaning of unknown words in context. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Answering using something you see at school.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Answering.
2. Explain Answering to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Answering.
4. Show that you can: summarise texts read by identifying main ideas
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Answering. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Answering important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. summarise texts read by identifying main ideas
2. determine the meaning of unknown words in context

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
